get.description:
Get current geometry configuration for a camera.

Returns the CameraGeometryConfig with all geometry details.

schema.title: Response Get Geometry Api V1 Geometry  Camera Id  Get

post.description:
Create or update geometry configuration for a camera.

Accepts full geometry config including line/zone, crossing policy, and metadata.

schema.title: Response Create Or Update Geometry Api V1 Geometry  Camera Id  Post

delete.description:
Delete geometry configuration for a camera.

Removes from memory and marks as deleted in version history.

schema.title: Response Delete Geometry Api V1 Geometry  Camera Id  Delete

put.description:
Update line geometry for a camera.

Only updates the line; preserves other config (zone, policy, metadata).

schema.title: Response Update Line Geometry Api V1 Geometry  Camera Id  Line Put

put.description:
Update zone geometry for a camera.

Only updates the zone; preserves other config (line, policy, metadata).

schema.title: Response Update Zone Geometry Api V1 Geometry  Camera Id  Zone Put

put.description:
Update crossing policy for a camera.

Only updates the policy; preserves geometry and metadata.

schema.title: Response Update Crossing Policy Api V1 Geometry  Camera Id  Policy Put

get.description: Get version history for a camera's geometry.

schema.title: Response Get Geometry Versions Api V1 Geometry  Camera Id  Versions Get

get.description: Get a specific version of geometry configuration.

schema.title: Response Get Geometry Version Api V1 Geometry  Camera Id  Versions  Version  Get
